## What it is

Airalo sells prepaid eSIM data plans for Austria. You buy a plan on Airalo's website or app and install it as an eSIM on your phone, alongside your usual SIM. Airalo's feed listed 24 local plans for Austria on 13 November 2026.

Prices are in USD, as Airalo's feed gives them. Price per GB is the plan price divided by its data allowance.

## How the plans work

The validity period starts when the eSIM connects to a mobile network in its coverage area. If you install the eSIM outside of the coverage area, you can connect to a network when you arrive. Every plan can be topped up. Some plans need ID verification (eKYC) first. Plan type: Data or Data, Calls, and Texts.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from Airalo's product feed, the plan list Airalo publishes for its affiliates. Airalo's checkout shows the final price and whether your phone supports eSIM.
